entrypoints.description: Authorization endpoint for OAuth2 authorization code flow.

entrypoints.label: POST /token
entrypoints.description: Token endpoint for both client credentials and authorization code flows.

entrypoints.label: GET /api/weather
entrypoints.description: Weather API endpoint that returns weather data for a city.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/tests
entrypoints.description: Lists all test JSON files for the given app.

entrypoints.label: POST /dev/apps/{app_name}/tests/run
entrypoints.description: Runs tests and streams pytest output.

entrypoints.label: PUT /dev/apps/{app_name}/tests/{test_name}
entrypoints.description: Creates or updates a test file from session data.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/tests/{test_name}
entrypoints.description: Fetches the content of a specific test file.

entrypoints.label: POST /dev/apps/{app_name}/eval_sets/{eval_set_id}
entrypoints.description: Creates an eval set, given the id.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/eval-sets
entrypoints.description: Lists all eval sets for the given app.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/eval_sets/{eval_set_id}/evals
entrypoints.description: Lists all evals in an eval set.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/eval-sets/{eval_set_id}/eval-cases/{eval_case_id}
entrypoints.description: Gets an eval case in an eval set.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/eval_sets/{eval_set_id}/evals/{eval_case_id}
entrypoints.description: Gets an eval case in an eval set.

entrypoints.label: POST /dev/apps/{app_name}/eval-sets/{eval_set_id}/run
entrypoints.description: Runs an eval given the details in the eval request.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/eval-results/{eval_result_id}
entrypoints.description: Gets the eval result for the given eval id.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/eval-results
entrypoints.description: Lists all eval results for the given app.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/metrics-info
entrypoints.description: Lists all eval metrics for the given app.

entrypoints.label: GET /dev/apps/{app_name}/graph
entrypoints.description: Returns the base agent graph in DOT format without any highlights. This endpoint allows the frontend to fetch the graph structure once and compute highlights client-side for better performance. Args: app_name: The name of the agent/app dark_mode: Whether to use dark theme background color

entrypoints.label: GET /apps/{app_name}/app-info
entrypoints.description: Returns the detailed info for a given ADK app.

entrypoints.label: PATCH /apps/{app_name}/users/{user_id}/sessions/{session_id}
entrypoints.description: Updates session state without running the agent. Args: app_name: The name of the application. user_id: The ID of the user. session_id: The ID of the session to update. req: The patch request containing state changes. Returns: The updated session. Raises: HTTPException: If the session is not found.

entrypoints.label: POST /apps/{app_name}/users/{user_id}/sessions/{session_id}/artifacts
entrypoints.description: Request payload for saving a new artifact.

entrypoints.label: PATCH /apps/{app_name}/users/{user_id}/memory
entrypoints.description: Adds all events from a given session to the memory service. Args: app_name: The name of the application. user_id: The ID of the user. update_memory_request: The memory request for the update Raises: HTTPException: If the memory service is not configured or the request is invalid.

entrypoints.label: POST /apps/{app_name}/trigger/pubsub
entrypoints.description: Processes a message from a Pub/Sub push subscription. Returns 200 on success; errors trigger Pub/Sub retry. Includes automatic retry with backoff on 429 errors.

entrypoints.label: POST /apps/{app_name}/trigger/eventarc
entrypoints.description: Processes a CloudEvent delivered by Eventarc. Returns 200 on success; errors trigger Eventarc retry. Includes automatic retry with backoff on 429 errors.
